classification.difficultyReason: Identify the exposed curved half-cylinder surface, convert diameter to radius and round the area to the nearest square metre.

content.prompt:
A shade shelter is to be constructed in the shape of half a cylinder with open ends.
The diameter is $3.8\text{ m}$ and the length is $10\text{ m}$.
The curved roof is to be made of plastic sheeting.
What area of plastic sheeting is required, to the nearest $\text{m}^2$?

spec.description: Open-ended half-cylinder shelter, with an unfilled front semicircular opening, hidden rear curve and longitudinal edge dashed, external diameter and length dimensions, and NOT TO SCALE.
spec.mathematics: The diameter is 3.8 m, the longitudinal length is 10 m, and only the curved semicylindrical roof contributes to the required area.
spec.answerVisibility: All diagram givens remain visible; no calculated radius or area is included.

answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}r&=\frac{3.8}{2}=1.9\text{ m}\\A&=\frac12(2\pi rh)\\A&=\frac12\bigl(2\pi(1.9)(10)\bigr)\\A&=19\pi\text{ m}^2\\A&\approx60\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$
Only the curved roof is required. The area is rounded to the nearest square metre.
